subject.title: docs: add Third-party UIs section to documentation (deepclaw-ui)

question: Should OpenClaw official Web docs list named third-party Gateway UIs such as MiniClaw/deepclaw-ui, or should this discovery live in a community/ClawHub-style surface instead?
rationale: The requested docs would promote an external UI that may handle Gateway credentials and sensitive workspace/session data, and repository vision leaves external promotion/provenance boundaries to maintainer judgment.

options.title: Review and land a guarded docs page
options.body: Accept a named third-party UI page after the linked PR fixes current project identity, browser-origin/security guidance, and merge conflicts.

options.title: Move discovery outside official docs
options.body: Close or re-scope the linked PR and keep external UI discovery in Showcase, Discord, ClawHub-style curation, or the external project repository.

options.title: Keep only generic integration guidance
options.body: Document the Gateway protocol and security checklist without naming specific external dashboards.

recommendation.title: Review and land a guarded docs page
recommendation.body: Accept a named third-party UI page after the linked PR fixes current project identity, browser-origin/security guidance, and merge conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs/Web history and product-boundary ownership signals make this the best available routing candidate for the curation decision.
